submitted.rationale: Out of the 3 measured compositions, index 11 (La0.77Sb0.23, close to La3SbO7) had the highest EQE at 0.0033%. The whole La–Sb oxide line probably absorbs very little at 2.1 eV because these are wide-gap oxides, so every measured EQE was close to the noise floor. XRD at 5 points showed mostly substrate peaks (Q≈2.78, 4.55, 5.33) plus weak film reflections, which get stronger toward the Sb-rich end. That was not enough to pick out a phase that absorbs visible light, so I spread the 3 EQE measurements over the Sb-rich, equimolar and La-rich regions.
